new_today_news.headline: Roanoke City Works to address bulk and brush pickup delays
new_today_news.summary: City of Roanoke addresses bulk and brush pickup service delays due to CDL driver shortage affecting Solid Waste Management operations. Crews prioritize trash and recycling pickup during weekdays, with weekend catch-up efforts underway.

new_today_news.headline: Heil Garbage Truck Electric Sideload Body RevAMP Transforms EV Waste Collection in Texas Case Study
new_today_news.summary: Heil's RevAMP all-electric sideload body demonstrates real-world performance improvements on residential MSW routes in Texas with optimized EV chassis utilization and reduced fuel consumption.

new_today_news.headline: Driver shortage disrupts brush and bulk pickup in Roanoke
new_today_news.summary: Roanoke experiencing delays in bulk and brush pickup amid ongoing CDL driver shortage. Solid Waste Management crews prioritize regular trash and recycling, with volunteers working extra hours weekends.

recent_news.headline: Shreveport garbage collection delays tied to shortage of CDL drivers
recent_news.summary: City of Shreveport reports garbage collection route delays due to shortage of qualified CDL drivers. Mayor notes city is short 11 drivers and can operate only 30 of 40 available garbage trucks weekly.

backfill_news.headline: Malaysia's FatHopes Energy and Vietnam's PVOIL Team Up for Sustainable Aviation Fuel Production
backfill_news.summary: FatHopes Energy, a Malaysian waste-based feedstock solutions firm for SAF, entered a strategic partnership with PetroVietnam Oil Corporation (PVOIL) to establish Vietnam's first nationwide used cooking oil collection ecosystem for sustainable aviation fuel production.

backfill_news.headline: Total M&A spending in 2026 surpasses $2.7B among top waste companies
backfill_news.summary: Major publicly traded solid waste and recycling companies spent more than $2 billion on mergers and acquisitions in Q2 2026, with year-to-date spending of $2.7 billion. Notable transactions include GFL Environmental's acquisition of Frontier Waste Solutions and Casella Waste Systems' acquisition of Star Waste Systems.

new_deals.target: Production tax credits from Diamond Green Diesel
deal_summary: Sale of IRA production tax credits; proceeds expected by end of Q3 2026
new_deals.notes: Darling Ingredients agreed to sell approximately $150 million in production tax credits generated by its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture (50/50 with Valero) under the Inflation Reduction Act. Diamond Green Diesel produces renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel with capacity exceeding 1.2 billion gallons annually.
